data.long_meaning: Garlen is a Greek name derived from the elements gar meaning 'spear' and leon meaning 'lion'. This name was borne by a character in a science fiction series, but its ancient origins evoke images of a strong and courageous ruler, overseeing a fertile and prosperous valley. The name Garlen carries the meaning “Ruler of the Valley” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Garlen usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the valley and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name truly embodies the Christian spirit of bravery and unwavering faith in the face of adversity.
